title: Fix uploaded video not appearing on feed

requirements.summary: Invalidate feed query cache after successful video upload so newly uploaded videos appear without manual refresh
acceptanceCriteria: After uploading a video and being navigated to the feed, the newly uploaded video is visible in the feed list.
The feed React Query cache is invalidated on successful createVideo mutation completion.
No manual page refresh is required for the new video to appear.

file_operations.description: Modify the useCreateVideo mutation hook to invalidate the 'videos' query key upon successful mutation completion using queryClient.invalidateQueries. This ensures the feed refetches the updated video list immediately after a new video is uploaded.

Verify that the Upload page navigates to the feed route after successful video creation and that the navigation occurs after the mutation has completed. Ensure the mutation's onSuccess callback is properly awaited or that navigation happens after cache invalidation triggers.
